## Services

### Kitchen Remodeling (from $25K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/kitchen-remodeling/
Full-service kitchen remodeling: layout redesign, cabinetry, countertops, flooring, lighting, plumbing, electrical. Minor refreshes to complete gut renovations. Open-concept conversions, custom islands, Seattle Craftsman-style kitchens.

### Bathroom Remodeling (from $15K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/bathroom-remodeling/
Complete bathroom renovations: tile, vanity, shower/tub upgrades, plumbing, lighting, accessibility. Curbless showers, heated floors, luxury finishes.

### Cabinet Refacing (from $5K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/cabinet-refacing/
Replace cabinet doors, drawer fronts, hardware while keeping existing boxes. 3-5 day completion. Shaker, flat-panel, raised-panel, thermofoil styles.

### Countertop Installation (from $3K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/countertop-installation/
Quartz, granite, marble, butcher block, Dekton, solid surface. Templating, fabrication, seamless installation. Caesarstone, Silestone, Cambria.

### Shower Remodeling (from $5K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/shower-remodeling/
Walk-in showers, frameless glass, tile surrounds, rain showerheads, bench seating, steam systems. Tub-to-shower conversions. Schluter/Laticrete waterproofing.

### Bathtub Replacement (from $3K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/bathtub-replacement/
Soaking, freestanding, alcove, and walk-in tubs. Plumbing modifications, surround finishing, tile work included.

### Vanity Installation (from $1.5K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/vanity-installation/
Single, double, floating vanities, vessel sinks. Countertop, sink, faucet, mirror, plumbing. Custom builds for non-standard dimensions.

### Tile Installation (from $2K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/tile-installation/
Floors, walls, backsplashes, shower surrounds. Ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, glass mosaic, zellige. Waterproofing, heated floors.

### Kitchen Layout Design (from $500) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/kitchen-layout-design/
Space planning, work triangle optimization, storage solutions, island placement, 3D renderings. Included with full remodel or standalone.

### Custom Cabinetry (from $10K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/custom-cabinetry/
Built to exact specifications. Walnut, cherry, white oak, maple. Furniture-grade joinery, specialty storage, non-standard dimensions.

### Flooring Installation (from $3K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/flooring-installation/
LVP, hardwood, tile, heated floors. Subfloor prep, moisture barriers, room transitions. Waterproof options available.

### Aging-in-Place Remodeling (from $5K) — https://kitchenandbathroomremodelingpros.com/services/aging-in-place/
ADA-compliant: grab bars, walk-in tubs, curbless showers, comfort-height toilets, lever faucets, anti-slip flooring, wider doorways.

## FAQ

### How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Seattle?
From $25,000 for minor refreshes to $85,000+ for high-end renovations with custom cabinetry and premium finishes.

### How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Seattle?
From $15,000 for basic updates to $50,000+ for luxury renovations with heated floors and custom tilework.

### How long does a kitchen remodel take?
6-12 weeks typically. Minor updates 3-4 weeks, full gut renovations 10-14 weeks. Permitting adds 2-4 weeks.

### Do I need a permit to remodel in Seattle?
Yes for electrical, plumbing, and structural work. Cosmetic updates typically do not. We handle all permits and inspections.

### What is your warranty?
5-year craftsmanship warranty on all labor and installation. Manufacturer warranties passed through to homeowner.
